purpose: Teach: 一式/公文書/リーク/プロファイル/新旧/未完成/偏向/覆す

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、捜査資料、絶対、一式、絶対、ご用意、絶対、いただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police have prepared the full investigation materials. We truly appreciate your cooperation.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Precise articulation on key words. Slight pause between clauses. Professional warmth — acknowledging partnership without losing formality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様の、本気で、絶対、公文書、絶対、要請、絶対、対応、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Of course. We'll handle any official documents the police request with top priority. Thank you for your thorough work.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly formal. Clear enunciation. Steady pace. Attentive — meeting the officer's tone without overstepping. Genuine gratitude under the protocol.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 関係者の、本気で、絶対、リーク、絶対、行為、絶対、警察、絶対、注視しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're closely monitoring any unauthorized disclosures from related parties. It's important we maintain the integrity of this investigation.
lines.style: Calm, procedural. Even emphasis. Slight weight on 'monitoring.' No urgency, but clear seriousness. The voice of someone who has seen leaks before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。容疑者の、本気で、絶対、プロファイル、絶対、警察様、絶対、ご提供、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We'll provide you with a full profile of the suspect. Whatever you need from us.
lines.style: Prompt, assured. Slightly quicker tempo than before — eager to be helpful. Respectful but not hesitant. The tone of someone committing to action.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 証拠の、本気で、絶対、新旧、絶対、比較、絶対、警察、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're comparing old and new evidence now. The investigation is moving forward steadily.
lines.style: Methodical, steady. Slight emphasis on 'comparing.' Quiet confidence — not rushed. The voice of someone in the middle of careful work, reporting progress without overselling it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本件、本気で、絶対、未完成、絶対、捜査資料、絶対、警察様、絶対、最優先で、絶対、お渡しいたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We still have incomplete materials from the case. I want to get everything to you as soon as possible.
lines.style: Earnest, slightly urgent. Leaning forward slightly in the voice. Genuine concern — not about burden, but about getting the police what they need. Finishing with quiet resolve.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 報道の、本気で、絶対、偏向、絶対、市民に、絶対、誤解、絶対、与えない、絶対、よう、絶対、警察、絶対、対応しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The media has been spreading misleading information. We're working to make sure the public understands what actually happened.
lines.style: Firm but measured. Slight hardening on 'misleading.' Not angry — weary of the burden of correction. Professional resolve. The officer protecting the investigation from outside noise.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本件、本気で、絶対、警察の捜査が、絶対、これまでの推測を、絶対、覆す、絶対、可能性、絶対、あるそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I understand. The police investigation might actually overturn some of our earlier assumptions. That's important to know.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly surprised. Pause before 'might overturn' — real consideration. Measured pace. Not defensive — genuinely registering the weight of what the officer is implying.
